title: Traditional French-Canadian Turkey Tourtière (Spiced Meat Pie)
ingredients: 1 large Russet potato, peeled, boiled, and finely mashed (binds the filling)
1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/4 tsp ground cloves, 1/4 tsp ground nutmeg, 1/4 tsp allspice, 1 tsp dried savory or thyme
1 double-crust pie pastry (bottom + top crust) & 1 beaten egg for egg wash
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). In a saucepan, simmer ground turkey, minced onion, celery, garlic, stock, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, allspice, savory, salt, and pepper over medium-low heat for 25 minutes until most liquid evaporates.
Stir the finely mashed potato into the warm spiced turkey mixture until cohesive and creamy; let cool slightly.
Line a 9-inch pie plate with the bottom pastry crust, spoon in the spiced turkey filling, and cover with the top crust. Crimp edges, cut steam vents, and brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes, then reduce to 350°F for 30–35 minutes until the crust is deep golden brown.
